test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster pair)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/366bba8ad593c36645ad485718d3bf3313016cb747d53165c9fedf1e46beb443.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) QL-NT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/412cb4b8d4f41281a0be4ba523ff3e14bfa0f875eea8b633482ed076c91d4750.png] 

Option 2) BW-YE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f70224f48eea038a182acca0c6531efaad765ffd830b56953ca5609b6e55ee4.png] 

Option 3) KF-HM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1c019c455ae7d6c88bbff0a5256dedad08e72cc61196ffbf8e29d958d2538ec.png] 

​Option 4) DY-AG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a42d861c2f57c2bad568dc69d9dba9f0631d7cba826784bc21201a2da7797fd.png] 

Thus, out of all 'KF-HM' is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
